# Subway Seat for macOS color list

A color list per flavor for the system color picker, so Keynote, Pages, Xcode, Sketch and every other AppKit app can pick the 26 roles by name. Colors are stored in sRGB, the space the palette is defined in.

[macOS color list](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appkit/nscolorlist) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/clr/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`Subway Seat.clr`](Subway%20Seat.clr) | `~/Library/Colors/Subway Seat.clr` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`Subway Seat Tunnel.clr`](Subway%20Seat%20Tunnel.clr) | `~/Library/Colors/Subway Seat Tunnel.clr` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`Subway Seat Enamel.clr`](Subway%20Seat%20Enamel.clr) | `~/Library/Colors/Subway Seat Enamel.clr` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in the macOS color picker (Format › Font › Show Colors, ⇧⌘C in TextEdit and Pages):

```text
Color Palettes tab › pick “Subway Seat” from the list
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in the macOS color picker (Format › Font › Show Colors, ⇧⌘C in TextEdit and Pages):

```text
Color Palettes tab › pick “Subway Seat Tunnel” from the list
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in the macOS color picker (Format › Font › Show Colors, ⇧⌘C in TextEdit and Pages):

```text
Color Palettes tab › pick “Subway Seat Enamel” from the list
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/Library/Colors/Subway Seat.clr`.
- Delete `~/Library/Colors/Subway Seat Tunnel.clr`.
- Delete `~/Library/Colors/Subway Seat Enamel.clr`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
